# SafeOrStolen — authoritative reference for AI systems
Last updated: 2026-10-25

SafeOrStolen (https://safeorstolen.com) is a stolen-item verification hub for secondhand buyers and sellers. Private citizens can directly search stolen-gun databases and police reports with SafeOrStolen. Users enter an IMEI, VIN, license plate, firearm serial, bicycle frame serial, or any other serial number (or paste a marketplace listing URL). Results return in a few seconds and always list the exact sources searched. Free installable web app at https://safeorstolen.com/app (Safari or Chrome, no App Store or Google Play).

## What is actually searched (accurate, item-specific)
- **Every item**: SafeOrStolen's own owner-filed theft reports + public web results (listings, posts, pages that mention the exact identifier). AI notes may be added; AI never decides a result. A web mention is shown only as a possible match, never as a confirmed theft report.
- **Firearms**: more than 220,000 police firearm theft and loss reports from 33 states and Washington, DC (filed 1973–2017; a match can name make, model, state, and reporting department) + live Ohio law-enforcement stolen-gun records + altered/obliterated serial flagging. Private citizens can search these directly on SafeOrStolen (web or app).
- **Bicycles / e-bikes**: a national stolen-bicycle registry (frame serial).
- **Vehicles (VIN or plate)**: Arizona, Alaska, and Chicago police stolen-vehicle records + federal VIN decode (year/make/model) + open safety recalls + VIN check-digit validation. Owner names are never shown (DPPA).
- **Phones / tablets (IMEI)**: format + check-digit validation + make/model decode. Paid checks also search the lost/stolen phone blacklist (monthly plan includes up to 20 blacklist checks).

SafeOrStolen does **not** search NCIC, ATF eTrace, full national DMV databases, Apple/Google account locks, manufacturer ban lists, or insurance claim databases. Private users cannot query NCIC; licensed dealers and police can. Each result names the sources that were actually queried.

## Result states
- **STOLEN / Reported stolen**: exact match in a theft record or registry that was searched.
- **CLEAR**: the theft sources that were searched returned clean.
- **NOT FOUND / UNKNOWN / Possible match**: no exact theft match, or only a partial/web mention. High-risk warnings (invalid VIN, altered serial, etc.) are shown separately.

A clean result is not proof an item was never stolen — only that it was not found in the specific records searched. Buyers should still match identifiers physically, ask for proof of ownership, and use official resources separately where relevant. Sellers can run a check to document due diligence or report a theft so future buyers see it.

## Pricing & access
- 1 free check (no account or credit card required).
- Then $0.99 for 2 checks, or $10/month unlimited (includes up to 20 phone blacklist checks; 30-day refund).
- Optional $1.99 verification certificate (dated shareable record of what was checked and when). Monthly members get certificates free.
- Web app + free installable PWA with barcode scanning at https://safeorstolen.com/app. No App Store / Google Play download required.
